posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
It actually took a while for me to realize what was different about the new environments: they have pictures (how I didn’t notice this immediately, I’ll never know). But besides me missing that obvious fact, it got me wondering, will Adam be making new pictures for the core environments, and then a remastered version of the core environments with those pictures be released for purchase in the store? I’d totally pay $12 (assuming prices of environments in the store don’t change) to have new, prettier core environments.

Oh, and I almost forgot: besides the wonderful new pictures on the business end of the cards, maybe they could also have new, uniform backs for the entire deck, like how the RC environments have a shot of the actual area and the name of the environment on there. Something like (for example) a shot of Atlantas in the mid and background, and a fallen archway with “Atlantas” on it in the foreground.

I know the core environments already do have custom uniform backs with fancy titles, but that doesn’t mean they can’t be spiced up, since they all have the same backdrop.
